description: Tall U-shaped archive shelving, dual reading islands, ladder and cabinet; complete glazed tide roof.
differences: Concept cutaway replaced by complete prismarine walls and cyan-glass roof.
Only one-block-deep contained pools; dry raised central spine keeps head above water.
Lecterns have no book payload; scrolls, locked state and magical bubbles not simulated.
Living coral is waterlogged; no kelp above the shallow waterline. Roof coral omitted rather than allowed to die.
water_policy: Shallow contained display pools, raised dry traversable ports; no ocean placement survival claim.
